main.description: A Bardcast character sheet: structured traits assembled from the player's prompt replies. Derived state — regenerated as more replies arrive. One current record per character at the `self` rkey.

traits.description: Named traits (ability scores, virtues, flaws, skills) inferred from replies.

drives.description: What motivates the character — used by the narrative engine.

sourceReplies.description: AT-URIs of the vox-pop reply records this sheet was derived from (provenance).

value.description: Free-form value (a number, a tag, or a phrase) so the same shape works for D&D stats and freeform systems.

confidence.description: How strongly the replies support this trait. Feeds the readiness gate.
